glsa.title: GPGME: Use-after-free
glsa.synopsis: A vulnerability has been discovered in GPGME which may result in remote code execution.

background.p: GnuPG Made Easy (GPGME) is a C language library that allows to add support for cryptography to a program. It is designed to make access to public key crypto engines like GnuPG or GpgSM easier for applications. GPGME provides a high-level crypto API for encryption, decryption, signing, signature verification and key management.

description.p: A vulnerability has been discovered in gpgme. Please review the CVE identifier referenced below for details.

impact.p: A remote attacker may be able to achieve code execution.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.
